before: Unlike Germinal, Prairial rebuilds sectional meetings and permanent sessions, circulates an insurrectionary program and mobilizes armed Guards. before: Explains the 1793-1794 amalgamation decrees, demi-brigade structure, slow implementation, and organizational effects. after: Explains the 1793-1794 amalgamation decrees, demi-brigade structure, slow implementation, and organizational effects. Standardization encouraged a new citizen-army self-image, contrasted with opponents’ mercenaries and reluctant serf conscripts. Unprecedented size made supply difficult; pitiless requisitioning and billeting initially burdened France's own frontier districts.

before: Patriotic motivation and homeland defense supported aggressive tactics among citizen soldiers. The citizen-army self-image coexisted with heavy requisitioning burdens and intensified combat violence.
after: Patriotic motivation and homeland defense supported aggressive mass tactics among citizen soldiers, whose enthusiasm and weight of numbers brought intensified combat violence and reduced restraint.
